headline: China refuses to cooperate with US economic war against Iran; Trump administration threatens the strictest sanctions in history
summary: The Trump administration threatened an economic war against Iran and sought global cooperation on sanctions. China, Iran's main oil buyer, refused, opposing illegal unilateral sanctions.
why: China is the largest buyer of Iranian crude, so sanctions enforcement on Iranian oil flows directly affects global crude supply and trade.
why_moved: Threatened US sanctions on Iran's oil trade, with China refusing to cooperate, raise the risk of tighter Iranian crude supply.
